gaps.topic: IonQ SPAC exhibit images and #AQ year pairing
gaps.why: www.sec.gov returned 403 to the declared user agent. The exhibit HTML was read from a Wayback capture dated 2026-09-28. Slide images returned HTTP 429. The exhibit’s hidden text lists algorithmic-qubit figures and the years 2021–2028, but the text order does not pair each figure to a year, so those figures were not split into targets.
gaps.would_need: The slide images g142872ex99_2p27g1.jpg and g142872ex99_2p44g1.jpg from the same exhibit, or another filing whose sentences pair each #AQ figure with a year.

gaps.topic: IonQ exhibit rows other than revenue
gaps.why: The same Summary Forecasted Financial Data table also lists systems online, costs, gross margin, EBITDA, net income, and free cash flow. Those rows were not entered as separate projections. EBITDA in the exhibit is a non-GAAP measure defined in the deck. Completeness of rd:ionq-2021-spac is partial for that reason, and because illustrative application slides were not itemized.
gaps.would_need: A decision to add each remaining table row, with 10-K lines only where the metric matches.

gaps.topic: GAAP revenue versus the exhibit’s revenue row
gaps.why: Footnote 2 of the exhibit says revenue channels were still being defined and that revenue may include prepayments, bookings, and recognized contracts. The actuals are the GAAP Revenue line from IonQ Forms 10-K, reported in thousands of dollars. Projected values in this file are the exhibit’s $M cells converted to dollars. Actual values are the thousands cells converted to dollars.
gaps.would_need: Counsel comparison of those two bases before any ratio is shown.

gaps.topic: Honeywell H0 day and later quantum-volume steps
gaps.why: The March 2021 and July 2021 Honeywell quantum-volume URLs returned a generic Honeywell page, not the articles. June 2020 and July 2021 figures used here come from Quantinuum’s 29 November 2021 post, which gives months but not days. The five-year order-of-magnitude wording runs to 2025; this file records the July 2021 quantum volume of 1024 and does not contain a 2024 or 2025 quantum-volume figure.
gaps.would_need: The June 2020 H0 release and any 2022–2025 Quantinuum quantum-volume announcements.

gaps.why: The Honeywell combination press-release URL returned 404, so this file does not record Honeywell as Quantinuum’s parent.
gaps.would_need: The 2021 combination release or a filing that names both parties and the ownership.

gaps.topic: Undated sentences left out of due dates
gaps.why: The 3 March 2020 Honeywell release says it will work with JPMorgan Chase, without a deadline, and says a paper will be posted later that day. Pasqal’s 12 March 2024 release describes offices still to open, without years. Pasqal’s 12 June 2025 roadmap says deployments are planned in Canada, the Middle East, and at CINECA, without a year. Those sentences are why several documents are marked partial.
gaps.would_need: A dated document for each of those sentences, if one exists.

gaps.topic: Pasqal roadmap page revising 200 logical qubits to 2029
gaps.why: https://www.pasqal.com/technology/roadmap/ contains the sentence about 200+ logical qubits by 2029 and a targeted demonstration by the end of Q1 2026, and it does not give a publication date. It was not used to revise the 12 June 2025 item.
gaps.would_need: A dated capture or a press release that states the 2029 figure.

gaps.topic: QuEra revision of the 2026 system and Helios delivery
gaps.why: A later QuEra statement moving the third-generation system, and a Quantinuum statement that Helios shipped, were not in the pages fetched here. The 2026 QuEra item is pending because 31 December 2026 has not passed. The Helios 2025 item is no_delivery_found in the pages checked.
gaps.would_need: QuEra’s later roadmap release and Quantinuum’s Helios announcement.

gaps.topic: Infleqtion street address and the earlier 30-logical-qubit target
gaps.why: The 24 September 2026 release gives Louisville, Colo., not a street. The 30-logical-qubit result is stated as achieved; the earlier sentence that set 30 as a 2026 target was not re-fetched, so it is not in this file as a target.
gaps.would_need: Infleqtion’s Form 10-K sentence that set the 30 figure, and a page that states the Louisville street address.

gaps.why: The Palaiseau coordinates and city precision are copied from the existing neutral-atom record. The 12 June 2025 Pasqal release fetched for this file says “Headquartered in France” and names Paris in the dateline. It does not name Palaiseau.
gaps.would_need: A Pasqal page fetched in this pass that states Palaiseau or the street address.

gaps.why: Direct requests to www.sec.gov returned 403. Exhibit 99.2 and the three IonQ Forms 10-K were read from Wayback Machine captures. IonQ’s investor-relations presentation page also returned 403.
gaps.would_need: Nothing further if counsel accepts the Wayback copies. The canonical SEC URLs are recorded on the sources.
